title: grindmn tube (part 1) - machining
_comment: Front is section A-A through the axis (y = 0). Axial steps are measured on the -x wall from the bottom face (datum, picked at x = -30.5 on the thread-zone annulus) so the +x bridge-screw hole and groove stay clear. Diameters are picked between the two section walls at a z clear of holes: the -x pilot wall is broken by the plunger hole (z 19.5..24.5) and the +x bridge-seat wall by the screw hole (z 113.35..116.65). Threads and the 90/270 burr-screw holes are given in the notes.
notes: 6061-T6. All seats, thread and OD in ONE chucking from the bottom (op 10). Bead blast, clear anodise type II, mask seats and thread.
Datum A = burr seat. Runout to A: pilot seat and bridge seat 0.010, thread pitch dia 0.03, OD 0.03. Shoulders at z 50 and 119 perpendicular 0.010 to A.
Radial holes (0 deg = index line): M4x0.7 thru wall at z 40, 90 and 270 deg (assumed, set from burr flats); M4x0.7 at z 115, 0 deg; plunger dia 5 H7 at z 22, 180 deg.
Thread M58x1-6H right-hand single-start, 0..10 from bottom, 30 deg entry chamfer to dia 59 x 1. Thread relief dia 59 at z 10..12.
General tolerance ISO 2768-mK, linear +-0.1, edges 0.3x45 (OD ends 0.5x45). Ra 1.6 on fits, 3.2 elsewhere.
Burr seat (A): measured burr OD +0.005/+0.015; dia 54 and its 20 depth are ASSUMED until the burr set is measured.
